value.name: Asha steadies herself before entering
value.description: Asha controls her breathing and composes herself before going into the conference room.
evidence: let her breath find a rhythm she could carry into the conference room

value.name: Rosa sends Asha a brief encouragement
value.description: Asha receives a text from Rosa telling her to go and win, signaling support before the meeting.
evidence: the phone at her hip buzzed once: Rosa, two words, Go. Win.

value.name: Asha ignores the text and heads in
value.description: Asha reads Rosa's message, puts the phone away without replying, and walks toward the conference room.
evidence: She read it, slid the phone back into her pocket without answering, and started toward the room

value.name: Mrs. Hatcher waits with untouched coffee
value.description: Mrs. Hatcher is already in the conference room, waiting with the firm's coffee untouched and unaware of Asha's weekend work.
evidence: Mrs. Hatcher was already waiting with a cup of the firm's coffee and no idea what the lawyer arguing for her children had spent the weekend doing.

value.name: Asha enters and takes control of the meeting
value.description: Asha opens the conference room door, enters calmly, greets Mrs. Hatcher, and sits across from her with the case folder.
evidence: Asha pushed the conference room door open with her shoulder and stepped in
Asha said good morning, took the chair across from her, and laid the folder down

value.name: Asha sets the meeting timeline
value.description: Asha tells Mrs. Hatcher they have less than three hours and that she will explain the order in which she plans to question the caseworker.
evidence: We have a little under three hours
and I want to walk you through the order I'm going to take the caseworker in.

value.name: Asha composes her body language
value.description: Asha deliberately avoids checking her watch and keeps her hands controlled until they settle, projecting calm authority.
evidence: She did not look at her watch, and she did not let her hands return to her lap until they had stopped needing to.

value.name: Asha reviews evidence with Mrs. Hatcher
value.description: Asha opens the folder to receipts and site-visit logs and shows Mrs. Hatcher the dates in sequence as she outlines her questioning strategy.
evidence: Asha opened the folder to the launderette receipts and the caseworker's site-visit log, fanning them so Mrs. Hatcher could see the dates in sequence
and walked her through the order she meant to take the agency witness in—employment timeline first, then the Wednesday and Friday drop-ins
